articles.title: 'We have to get tougher.' Reds 2026 numbers tell story of weak season
articles.description: Cincinnati Reds manager Terry Francona's message to his last-place team heading to the offseason: "We have to get tougher." These numbers back him up.

articles.title: Reds star Elly De La Cruz earns another MLB honor after 30-30 season
articles.description: "He's more special than I thought," teammate Eugenio Suárez said of Cincinnati Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz, the NL Player of the Month.

articles.title: How Reds might get one last shot to help make history in season finale
articles.description: Hall of Fame-bound pitcher Max Scherzer has decided to start Sunday against the Cincinnati Reds in what might be the final start of his career.

articles.title: Reds 'have to get tougher,' Cincinnati manager Terry Francona says
articles.description: The Cincinnati Reds lost 5-1 in Toronto in the season finale as Max Scherzer pitched into the 8th in what might be his final start. Reds finish 75-87.

articles.title: Reds lose as supporting cast in Max Scherzer's possible career finale
articles.description: Hall of Fame-bound pitcher Max Scherzer pitched into the eighth inning on short rest to beat the Cincinnati Reds 5-1 in what might be his final game.

articles.title: Failed reunion with Reds leaves Eugenio Suárez mulling what comes next
articles.description: HR season, Eugenio Suárez started slow, got hurt, then produced too little too late to help the Reds avoid a last-place finish.

articles.title: Cincinnati Reds RHP Tony Santillan has hip surgery to remove bone spur
articles.description: Cincinnati Reds right-hander Tony Santillan struggled much of the season, landing on the injured list twice for oblique and hip injuries.

articles.title: What comes after 30-30 season even bigger for Elly De La Cruz, Reds
articles.description: Cincinnati Reds SS Elly De La Cruz finished the fourth 30-30 season in franchise history with a steal Friday. What's next for the All-Star and team?

articles.title: If Reds pull off shocking turnaround in 2027, it might look like this
articles.description: Cincinnati Reds left-handers Brandon Williamson and Andrew Abbott combined for 13 IP and 2 runs allowed vs. the playoff-bound Braves the last 2 games.

articles.title: Rhett Lowder shows what '27 must look like for Reds to have any chance
articles.description: The Cincinnati Reds rotation was one of the best in the majors in 2025, and they snuck into the playoffs. They're among the worst in 2026. Go figure.

articles.title: Rob Lowe says he'll be dead before Reds return to World Series
articles.description: Rob Lowe confirmed he's a bigger Dodgers fan than Reds fan, and shared pessimism about the Reds' World Series chances, potentially for years to come.
